Theory TD_wn_phases

section ‹TD with Widening and Narrowing in Phases›

text‹In this theory, we prove the termination of the TD with widening and narrowing applied in
  two phases per iteration on an unknown. This extended TD also dynamically identifies unknowns
  at which widening and narrowing is applied. While it terminates for arbitrary equation system
  as long as the set of unknowns is finite, it may not necessarily return a partial post-solution.
  With a widening operator that is precise and for an equation system where right-hand sides are
  monotonic and have monotonic dependencies the returning of a partial post-solution can, however,
  be guaranteed. We prove this in the accompanying theory file by showing the phase TD specified
  here to be equivalent to the TD extended with the combined warrowing operator.›

theory TD_wn_phases
  imports Basics Destabilization TD
begin

datatype phase = Widening | Narrowing

text‹The TD with widening/narrowing phases uses a set @{term point} to dynamically track unknowns
  at which widening and narrowing should be applied. @{term point} is tracked as part of the
  solver state among the components already used by the vanilla TD:
   @{term c} to track already called unknowns, @{term σ} to track the current unknown-to-value
  mapping, and @{term stabl} and @{term infl} to track unknowns and their dependencies which need
  not be re-iterated because their value is unchanged since their last iteration.›

record ('x,'d) state = "('x,'d) state" +
  point :: "'x set"

locale TD_wn_phases =
  fixes T :: "('x,'d::order_bot) eqsT"
  fixes widening :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇" 65)
    and narrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "Δ" 70)
begin

subsection ‹Definitions›

function (domintros)
    query :: "'x ⇒ 'x ⇒ ('x, 'd) state ⇒ 'd × ('x, 'd) state" and
  iterate :: "'x ⇒ phase ⇒ ('x, 'd) state ⇒ 'd × ('x, 'd) state" and
     eval :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'd) strategy_tree ⇒ ('x, 'd) state ⇒ 'd × ('x, 'd) state"
     where
  "query y x state = (
    let (xd, state) =
      if x ∈ called state then (mlup (σ state) x, state⦇point := insert x (point state)⦈)
      else iterate x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)
    in (xd, state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y⦈))"
| "iterate x phase state = (
    if x ∉ stabl state then (
      let point⇩x = x ∈ point state in
      let (xd, state) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) in
      let d = if ¬ point⇩x then xd
              else if phase = Widening then mlup (σ state) x ∇ xd else mlup (σ state) x Δ xd in
      if d = mlup (σ state) x then (
        if point⇩x ∧ phase = Widening then (
          let d = mlup (σ state) x Δ xd in
          if d = mlup (σ state) x then
            (d, state⦇called := (called state) - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈)
          else (
            let (infl, stabl) = destab x (infl state) (stabl state) in
            iterate x Narrowing (state⦇infl := infl, stabl := stabl, σ := (σ state)(x ↦ d)⦈)))
        else (d, state⦇called := (called state) - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈))
      else (
        let (infl, stabl) = destab x (infl state) (stabl state) in
        iterate x phase (state⦇infl := infl, stabl := stabl, σ := (σ state)(x ↦ d)⦈)))
    else
      (mlup (σ state) x, state⦇called := (called state) - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈))"
| "eval x t state = (case t of
      Answer d ⇒ (d, state)
    | Query y g ⇒ (let (yd, state) = query x y state in eval x (g yd) state))"
  by pat_completeness auto

definition solve :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'd) map × 'x set" where
  "solve x = (
    let state = ⦇called = {}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈ in
    let (_, state) = iterate x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)
    in (σ state, stabl state))"

definition query_dom where
  "query_dom y x state = query_iterate_eval_dom (Inl (y, x, state))"
declare query_dom_def [simp]
definition iterate_dom where
  "iterate_dom x wn state =
    query_iterate_eval_dom (Inr (Inl (x, wn, state)))"
declare iterate_dom_def [simp]
definition eval_dom where
  "eval_dom x t state = query_iterate_eval_dom (Inr (Inr (x, t, state)))"
declare eval_dom_def [simp]

definition solve_dom where
  "solve_dom x =
    iterate_dom x Widening ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"

lemmas dom_defs = query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def


subsection ‹Refinement of Auto-generated Rules›

lemmas query_iterate_eval_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Query Iterate Eval]
  = query_iterate_eval.pinduct(1)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of y x state for y x state
    ]
    query_iterate_eval.pinduct(2)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of x wn state for x wn state
    ]
    query_iterate_eval.pinduct(3)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of x t state for x t state
    ]

lemmas iterate_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Iterate]
  = query_iterate_eval_pinduct(2)[where ?P="λy x state. True"
    and ?R="λx t state. True", simplified (no_asm_use),
    folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def]

declare query.psimps [simp]
declare iterate.psimps [simp]
declare eval.psimps [simp]

subsection ‹Domain Lemmas›

lemma dom_backwards_pinduct:
  shows "query_dom y x state
    ⟹ x ∉ called state ⟹ iterate_dom x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
  and "iterate_dom x wn state
    ⟹ x ∉ stabl state ⟹ (eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) ∧
        ((xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
          ⟶ d_new = (if x ∉ point state then xd
                else if wn = Widening then mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd else mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)
          ⟶ (d_new = mlup (σ state1) x ⟶ x ∈ point state ⟶ wn = Widening
          ⟶ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd ≠ mlup (σ state1) x
          ⟶ (infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)
          ⟶ iterate_dom x Narrowing (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
                σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈))
          ∧ (d_new ≠ mlup (σ state1) x
             ⟶ (infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1) ⟶
             iterate_dom x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
                σ := (σ state1)(x↦d_new)⦈))))"
  and "eval_dom x (Query y g) state
    ⟹ (query_dom x y state ∧
        ((yd, state') = query x y state ⟶ eval_dom x (g yd) state'))"
proof (induction y x state and x wn state and x "Query y g" state
    arbitrary: and xd state1 d_new infl2 stabl2 and y g yd state'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case
    using Query(1) Query(2)[OF Query(3), simplified]
      query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x "state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈" Widening]
    by fastforce
next
  case (Iterate x wn state)

  have eval_dom: "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Iterate.hyps(2) Iterate.prems query_iterate_eval.domintros(3) by force

  show ?case
  proof (intro impI conjI, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then show ?case using eval_dom by force
  next
    case 2
    have B: "x ∈ point state ∧ wn = Widening" using 2(4,5) by simp
    show ?case
      using Iterate.hyps(3)[OF Iterate.prems _ 2(1) _ 2(2,3) B _ 2(6,7), simplified]
          query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x "state1⦇infl := infl2,
          stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈" Narrowing]
        by fastforce
  next
    case 3
    show ?case
      using Iterate.hyps(4)[OF Iterate.prems _ 3(1) _ 3(2-4), simplified]
        iterate_dom_def query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x "state1⦇infl := infl2,
        stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈" wn]
      by fastforce
  qed
next
  case (Eval x state)
  then show ?case using query_iterate_eval.domintros(1,3) by simp
qed


subsection ‹Case Rules›

lemma iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases_basic[consumes 3]:
  assumes "iterate_dom x wn state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x wn state"
  obtains (Stable) "x ∈ stabl state"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state⦇called := (called state) - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈"
  | (Fixpoint) state1
  where "x ∉ stabl state" and "x ∉ point state"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "state' = state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  | (W_Fixpoint) xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2
  where "x ∉ stabl state" and "x ∈ point state" and "wn = Widening"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1 ≠ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "iterate_dom x Narrowing (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x Narrowing (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈)"
  | (N_Fixpoint) xd1 state1
  where "x ∉ stabl state" and "x ∈ point state"
    and "wn = Narrowing ∨ (wn = Widening ∧ mlup (σ state') x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state') x)"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x Δ xd1"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
    and "state' = state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
  | (Continue) xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2
  where "x ∉ stabl state"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "d_new = (if x ∉ point state then xd1 else
          if wn = Widening then mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)"
    and "d_new ≠ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "iterate_dom x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') =
          iterate x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
proof(cases "x ∈ stabl state" rule: case_split[case_names Stable Unstable])
  case Stable
  then show ?thesis using that(1) assms(1,2) by auto
next
  case Unstable
  then have sldom: "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2)
    by simp
  then obtain xd1 state1
    where slapp: "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) = (xd1, state1)"
    by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
  then obtain d_new where d_new: "d_new = (if x ∉ point state then xd1
    else if wn = Widening then mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)"
    by blast
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x = d_new" rule: case_split[case_names Fixpoint Continue])
    case Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "x ∈ point state")
      case True
      then show ?thesis
      proof (cases wn)
        case Widening
        obtain infl2 stabl2 where
          destab: "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1) = (infl2, stabl2)"
          by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)")
        have d_new: "d_new = mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1" using d_new Widening True by simp
        show ?thesis
        proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1 = mlup (σ state1) x")
          case True
          then have "iterate x wn state = (mlup (σ state1) x,
              state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈)"
            using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] ‹x ∈ point state› Unstable slapp
              Fixpoint d_new Widening True
            by force
          then have "xd = mlup (σ state1) x" "state' = state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x},
              point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
            using assms(2) by auto
          moreover have "mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state1) x"
            using Fixpoint d_new by auto
          ultimately show ?thesis
            using that(4)[OF Unstable ‹x ∈ point state› _ sldom slapp[symmetric]] True Widening by simp
        next
          case False
          have "mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state1) x" using d_new Fixpoint by simp
          moreover have "(xd, state') = iterate x Narrowing
              (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈)"
            using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Widening
              True destab False assms(2)
            by force
          moreover have "iterate_dom x Narrowing
              (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈)"
            using Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Widening True assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2) destab
              False
            by simp
          ultimately show ?thesis
            using that(3)[OF Unstable True Widening sldom slapp[symmetric] _ False destab[symmetric]]
            by simp
        qed
      next
        case Narrowing
        have "d_new = mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1" using d_new Narrowing True by simp
        moreover have "iterate x wn state = (mlup (σ state1) x, state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x},
            point := (point state1) - {x}⦈)"
          using assms iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new Narrowing
            True
          by fastforce
        ultimately show ?thesis
          using Unstable sldom slapp d_new assms that(4)[OF Unstable True _ sldom] Narrowing Fixpoint
          by auto
      qed
    next
      case False
      have "iterate x wn state = (mlup (σ state1) x, state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x},
          point := (point state1) - {x}⦈)"
        using assms iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable slapp Fixpoint d_new
          False
        by simp
      then show ?thesis
        using Unstable sldom slapp d_new assms that(2)[OF Unstable False sldom] False Fixpoint
        by auto
    qed
  next
    case Continue
    obtain infl2 stabl2 where destab: "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1) = (infl2, stabl2)"
      by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)")
    then have dom: "iterate_dom x wn
        (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
      using Unstable Continue slapp d_new assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2) by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Unstable Continue sldom slapp d_new assms destab that(3,5)
      by (cases "x ∈ point state") (auto simp add: Let_def)
  qed
qed

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic[consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  obtains (Iterate) state1
  where "x ∉ called state"
    and "iterate_dom x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = iterate x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "state' = state1⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈"
  | (Lookup) "x ∈ called state"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y, point := insert x (point state)⦈"
  using assms that dom_backwards_pinduct(1)
  by (cases "x ∈ called state"; auto split: prod.splits)

lemma eval_query_answer_cases[consumes 2]:
  assumes "eval_dom x t state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t state"
  obtains (Query) y g yd state1
  where "t = Query y g"
    and "query_dom x y state"
    and "(yd, state1) = query x y state"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) state1"
  | (Answer) "t = Answer xd"
    and "state' = state"
  using assms dom_backwards_pinduct(3) that
  by (cases t; auto split: prod.splits)

lemma c_same: "query_dom y x state ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state ⟹ called state' = called state"
              "iterate_dom x wn state ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x wn state
               ⟹ called state' = called state - {x}"
              "eval_dom x t state ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state ⟹ called state' = called state"
proof (induction y x state and x wn state and x t state
       arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
       rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic)
    case (Iterate state1)
    show ?thesis using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3)] Iterate(1,4) by simp
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x wn state)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases_basic)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl] Fixpoint(1,3-5) by simp
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl] Iterate.IH(3)[OF _ refl _ refl refl] W_Fixpoint(1-3,5-8,10)
      by simp
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl] N_Fixpoint(1,5,8) by simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl] Iterate.IH(4)[OF _ refl _ refl refl _ refl] Continue(1,3-6,8)
      by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    show ?thesis using Eval.IH(2) Eval.IH(3)[OF _ _ refl] Query(1,3,5) by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
qed

lemma iterate_fmlookup:
  assumes "iterate_dom x wn state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x wn state"
  shows "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  using assms
proof(induction rule: iterate_pinduct)
  case (Iterate x wn state)
  show ?case
    using Iterate.hyps Iterate.prems
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases_basic)
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(1)[OF _ refl _ refl refl _ _ _ _ refl] W_Fixpoint(1-3,5-8,10)
      by simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl _ refl _ _ _ refl] Continue(1,3-6,8) by auto
  qed (simp add: Iterate)
qed

corollary query_fmlookup:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  shows "mlup (σ state') x = xd"
proof (cases "x ∈ called state")
  case True
  then show ?thesis using assms by simp
next
  case False
  have idom: "iterate_dom x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    using assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(1)[OF assms(1) False] by simp
  show ?thesis using assms False iterate_fmlookup[OF idom] by (simp split: prod.splits)
qed

lemma iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases[consumes 3]:
  assumes "iterate_dom x wn state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x wn state"
  obtains (Stable) "x ∈ stabl state"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state⦇called := (called state) - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈"
  | (Fixpoint) state1
  where "x ∉ stabl state" and "x ∉ point state"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "state' = state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  | (W_Fixpoint) xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2
  where "x ∉ stabl state" and "x ∈ point state" and "wn = Widening"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1 ≠ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "iterate_dom x Narrowing (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x Narrowing (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(x↦mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  | (N_Fixpoint) xd1 state1
  where "x ∉ stabl state" and "x ∈ point state"
    and "wn = Narrowing ∨ (wn = Widening ∧ mlup (σ state') x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state') x)"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x Δ xd1"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
    and "state' = state1⦇called := (called state1) - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  | (Continue) xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2
  where "x ∉ stabl state"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "d_new = (if x ∉ point state then xd1 else
          if wn = Widening then mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)"
    and "d_new ≠ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "iterate_dom x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') =
          iterate x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  apply (rule iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases_basic[OF assms])
  using iterate_fmlookup[OF assms]
  by blast+

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases[consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  obtains (Iterate) state1
  where "x ∉ called state"
    and "iterate_dom x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = iterate x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "state' = state1⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x"
  | (Lookup) "x ∈ called state"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y, point := insert x (point state)⦈"
  apply (rule query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic[OF assms])
  using query_fmlookup[OF assms]
  by blast+

end


subsection ‹Termination›

locale TD_wn_phases_term = TD_wn_phases T for
  T :: "('x, 'd :: order_bot) eqsT" +

  assumes finite_vars: "finite (UNIV :: 'x set)"

  fixes widening_chains narrowing_chains :: "('d × 'd) set"
  defines widening_chains: "widening_chains ≡ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}"
    and narrowing_chains: "narrowing_chains ≡ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}"
  assumes widening_finite: "wf widening_chains"
    and narrowing_finite: "wf narrowing_chains"
begin

subsubsection‹Construction of Well-founded Relation for Termination Proof›

type_synonym ('a,'b) query_in = "'a × 'a × ('a, 'b) state"
type_synonym ('a,'b) iterate_in = "'a × phase × ('a, 'b) state"
type_synonym ('a,'b) eval_in = "'a × ('a, 'b) strategy_tree × ('a, 'b) state"


text ‹We define the termination relation as a lexicographic order over 5-tuples. The first
  component characterizes that the solver may only descend into finitely many unknowns, the second
  describes an order between the three mutual recursive functions, and the third ensures that only
  finitely many unknowns are queried in a right-hand side. The fourth component guarantees that an
  unknown is not iterated infinitely often without becoming a  widening/narrowing point and the
  fifth lastly ensures that iteration of a widening/narrowing point terminates based on the
  properties of the widening and narrowing operator.›

definition value_relation :: "((phase × 'd) × (phase × 'd)) set" where
  "value_relation = {((p2,d2),(p1,d1)). p1 = Widening ∧ p2 = Narrowing}
    ∪ {((p1,d1),(p2,d2)). p1 = Widening ∧ p2 = Widening ∧ (d1,d2) ∈ widening_chains}
    ∪ {((p1,d1),(p2,d2)). p1 = Narrowing ∧ p2 = Narrowing ∧ (d1,d2) ∈ narrowing_chains}"

lemma wf_value_relation: "wf value_relation"
proof (intro wfI_min, goal_cases)
  case (1 t Q)
  define Q⇩N where qn_def: "Q⇩N = {(p,d) ∈ Q. p = Narrowing}"
  define Q⇩W where qw_def: "Q⇩W = {(p,d) ∈ Q. p = Widening}"
  have "Q = Q⇩N ∪ Q⇩W" unfolding qn_def qw_def using phase.exhaust by blast
  define Qd⇩N where qdn_def: "Qd⇩N = {d. (Narrowing,d) ∈ Q}"
  define Qd⇩W where qdw_def: "Qd⇩W = {d. (Widening,d) ∈ Q}"

  show ?case
  proof (cases "Qd⇩N = {}")
    case True
    then obtain dt where "t = (Widening,dt)"
      using 1 qdn_def qdw_def phase.exhaust
      by (metis (mono_tags, lifting) ex_in_conv mem_Collect_eq old.prod.exhaust)
    then have "dt ∈ Qd⇩W" using qdw_def 1 by auto
    then obtain d⇩m⇩i⇩n where d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def: "d⇩m⇩i⇩n ∈ Qd⇩W" "∀d'. (d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ widening_chains ⟶ d' ∉ Qd⇩W"
      by (metis wfE_min widening_finite)
    then have "(Widening,d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ Q" using qdw_def by simp
    moreover have "((p',d'),(Widening,d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation ⟶ (p',d') ∉ Q" for p' d'
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "((p', d'), (Widening, d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation" "(p', d') ∈ Q" by auto
      have "p' = Widening" using ‹(p', d') ∈ Q› True unfolding qdn_def by (cases p') auto
      then have "(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ widening_chains"
        using ‹((p', d'), (Widening, d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation› unfolding value_relation_def by auto
      have "d' ∈ Qd⇩W" using qdw_def ‹(p', d') ∈ Q› ‹p' = Widening› by simp
      moreover have "d' ∉ Qd⇩W" using d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def ‹(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ widening_chains› by auto
      ultimately show ?case by simp
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case False
    then obtain d⇩m⇩i⇩n where d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def: "d⇩m⇩i⇩n ∈ Qd⇩N" "∀d'. (d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ narrowing_chains ⟶ d' ∉ Qd⇩N"
      by (metis ex_in_conv wfE_min narrowing_finite)
    then have "(Narrowing,d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ Q" using qdn_def by simp
    moreover have "((p',d'),(Narrowing,d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation ⟶ (p',d') ∉ Q" for p' d'
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "((p', d'), (Narrowing, d⇩m⇩i⇩n)) ∈ value_relation" "(p', d') ∈ Q" by auto
      then have "p' = Narrowing" "(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ narrowing_chains" unfolding value_relation_def by auto
      have "d' ∈ Qd⇩N" using qdn_def ‹(p', d') ∈ Q› ‹p' = Narrowing› by simp
      moreover have "d' ∉ Qd⇩N" using d⇩m⇩i⇩n_def ‹(d',d⇩m⇩i⇩n) ∈ narrowing_chains› by auto
      ultimately show ?case by simp
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

definition prod_relation :: "((nat × nat × ('x, 'd) strategy_tree × bool × (phase × 'd))
    × (nat × nat × ('x, 'd) strategy_tree × bool × (phase × 'd))) set" where
  "prod_relation = lex_prod (measure id) (lex_prod (measure id) (lex_prod
    strict_subt_relation (lex_prod (measure (λb. if ¬ b then 1 else 0)) value_relation)))"

lemma wf_prod_relation: "wf prod_relation"
  unfolding prod_relation_def
  using widening_finite wf_rhs_relation wf_value_relation
  by auto

definition term_relation :: "((('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in) ×
   (('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in)) set"
  where
  "term_relation = inv_image prod_relation (λst. case st of
      Inl (x,y,state) ⇒ (card (UNIV - (called state)), 1, T y, False, (Widening, mlup (σ state) y))
    | Inr (Inl (x,wn,state)) ⇒
        (card (UNIV - (called state)), 3, T x, x ∈ point state, (wn, mlup (σ state) x))
    | Inr (Inr (x,t,state)) ⇒ (card (UNIV - (called state)), 2, t, False, (Widening, mlup (σ state) x)))"

lemma wf_term_relation: "wf term_relation"
  unfolding term_relation_def
  by (simp add: wf_prod_relation)


subsubsection‹Auxiliary Lemmas›

lemma constant_vals_for_called:
  shows "query_dom y x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
    ⟹ (∀u ∈ called state. mlup (σ state') u = mlup (σ state) u)"
    and "iterate_dom x wn state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x wn state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ (∀u ∈ (called state) - {x}. mlup (σ state') u = mlup (σ state) u)"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ (∀u ∈ called state. mlup (σ state') u = mlup (σ state) u)"
proof(induction y x state and x wn state and x t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    show ?thesis using Query.IH(2) Iterate(1,3,4) by simp
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x wn state)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl] by simp
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "∀u∈called state. mlup (σ state1) u = mlup (σ state) u"
      using Iterate.IH(2) W_Fixpoint(1,5) by simp
    moreover have IH2:
      "∀u∈called state - {x}. mlup (σ state') u = mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)) u"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[rotated 11, OF W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(1-3,5-8)
        Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(4,5)]
      by simp
    moreover have
      "∀u∈called state - {x}. mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)) u = mlup (σ state1) u"
      by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2) N_Fixpoint(1,5,8) by simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "∀u∈called state. mlup (σ state1) u = mlup (σ state) u"
      using Iterate.IH(2) Continue(1,3) by simp
    moreover have IH2: "∀u∈called state - {x}. mlup (σ state') u = mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)) u"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[rotated 8, OF Continue(8)] Continue(1,3-6) Iterate.prems(2)
        c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)]
      by simp
    ultimately show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have IH1: "∀u∈called state. mlup (σ state1) u = mlup (σ state) u"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] by simp
    have IH2: "∀u∈called state. mlup (σ state') u = mlup (σ state1) u"
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5)] c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3)] by simp
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

lemma point_set_subset_c:
  shows "query_dom y x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
    ⟹ point state ⊆ called state
    ⟹ point state' ⊆ called state'"
    and "iterate_dom x wn state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x wn state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ point state - {x} ⊆ called state - {x}
    ⟹ point state' - {x} ⊆ called state' - {x} ∧ x ∉ point state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ point state ⊆ called state
    ⟹ point state' ⊆ called state'"
proof(induction y x state and x wn state and x t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    have IH: "point state' ⊆ (insert x (called state')) - {x}"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3)] Query.prems(2) Iterate(4) by auto
    moreover have "x ∉ point state" using Iterate(1) Query.prems(2) by auto
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x wn state)
  have point_sub_c: "point state ⊆ called state" using Iterate.prems(2,3) by auto
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl Fixpoint(4)] Fixpoint(1,2,5) point_sub_c by auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "point state1 ⊆ called state1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) _ W_Fixpoint(5)] Iterate.prems(2) point_sub_c by auto
    have IH2: "point state' ⊆ called state' - {x}"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) _ W_Fixpoint(5) _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(4,5)] IH1
      by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 c_same(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(9,10)] by auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1) _ N_Fixpoint(5)] N_Fixpoint(8) point_sub_c by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "point state1 - {x} ⊆ called state1 - {x}"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3)] point_sub_c by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3) _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(8)]
        Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)]
      by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have IH1: "point state1 ⊆ called state1" using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2) by auto
    have IH2: "point state' ⊆ called state'" using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5)] IH1(1) by auto
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2) by auto
  qed
qed

lemma stabl_infl_properties:
    shows "query_dom y x state
      ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
      ⟹ called state ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ stabl state ⊆ stabl state' ∧ fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'
          ∧ (∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {y}) = {})"
      and "iterate_dom x wn state
      ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x wn state
      ⟹ x ∈ called state
      ⟹ called state - {x} ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state' ∧ fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'
          ∧ (∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {x}) = {})"
      and "eval_dom x t state
      ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
      ⟹ called state ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ stabl state ⊆ stabl state' ∧ fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'
          ∧ (∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {x}) = {})"
proof(induction y x state and x wn state and x t state
      arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
      rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    have "insert x (called state) - {x} ⊆ stabl state"
      using Iterate(4) Query.prems(2) by (auto split: if_splits)
    then have IH: "insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state'"
      "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state'"
      "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {x}) = {}"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3)] Query.prems(3) Iterate(4) by auto
    show ?thesis
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case using IH(1) Iterate(4) by (auto split: if_splits)
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case using IH(1,2) Iterate(4) fmdom_fmupd unfolding fminsert_def by auto
    next
      case 3
      have IH': "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
        using IH(3) Iterate(2,3) by (cases "x ∈ stabl state") auto
      then have "(slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {y}) = {}"
        for u
        using Iterate(4)
        by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
      then show ?case by auto
    qed
  next
    case Lookup
    have "(slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {y}) = {}" for u
      using Lookup(3)
      by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
    then show ?thesis using Query(4,5) Lookup(1,3) unfolding fminsert_def by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x wn state)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3,4) Stable(1,3) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl Fixpoint(4)] Fixpoint(1,5) Iterate.prems(3,4) by auto
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "stabl state ⊆ stabl state1" "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
      "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF _ refl W_Fixpoint(5)] Iterate.prems(3,4) W_Fixpoint(1) by auto
    then have "influenced_by (infl state1) x ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
      using TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4)
      by meson
    then have "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)] ‹stabl state ⊆ stabl state1› by auto
    then have "called state - {x} ⊆ stabl2" using Iterate.prems(3) by blast
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      by (simp add: IH1(2) destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl W_Fixpoint(8))
    ultimately have
      IH2: "insert x stabl2 ⊆ stabl state'" "fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'"
      "∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup infl2 u) ∩ (stabl2 - {x}) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) _ W_Fixpoint(5) _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
            W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(4,5)] by auto
    have "(slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {x}) = {}" for u
    proof -
      have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)]
        by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subset_iff)
      then show ?thesis using IH2(3) IH1(3) ‹stabl state ⊆ stabl2› by blast
    qed
    then show ?thesis using IH2 ‹stabl state ⊆ stabl2› by auto
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1) refl N_Fixpoint(5)] N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(3,4)
      by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state1" "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
        "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u)
          ∩ (insert x (stabl state) - {x}) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3)] Iterate.prems(3,4) by auto
    then have "influenced_by (infl state1) x ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
      using TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl Iterate.prems(4) Continue(1) by simp
    then have "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
      using ‹insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state1› destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
      by blast
    then have "called state - {x} ⊆ stabl2" using Iterate.prems(3) by blast
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      by (simp add: IH1(2) destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl Continue(6))
    ultimately have IH2: "insert x stabl2 ⊆ stabl state'"
        "fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'"
        "∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup infl2 u) ∩ (stabl2 - {x}) = {}"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3) _ Continue(4,5,6) _ Continue(8)]
        Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)]
      by auto
    have "(slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {x}) = {}" for u
    proof -
      have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
        by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subset_iff)
      then show ?thesis using IH2(3) IH1(3) ‹stabl state ⊆ stabl2› by blast
    qed
    then show ?thesis using IH2 ‹stabl state ⊆ stabl2› by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have IH1: "stabl state ⊆ stabl state1" "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
        "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ ((stabl state) - {x}) = {}"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2,3) by auto
    have "called state ⊆ stabl state1" using IH1(1) Eval.prems(2) by auto
    then have IH2: "stabl state1 ⊆ stabl state'" "fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'"
        "∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state1) u) ∩ (stabl state1 - {x}) = {}"
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5)] IH1(2,3) c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3)] by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 ‹stabl state ⊆ stabl state1› by blast
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2,3) by auto
  qed
qed

lemma called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point:
  shows "query_dom y x state
         ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
         ⟹ called state ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ {u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state
         ⟹ {u ∈ called state'. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state'"
    and "iterate_dom x phase state
         ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x phase state
         ⟹ x ∈ called state
         ⟹ called state - {x} ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ {u ∈ called state - {x}. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state - {x}
         ⟹ {u ∈ called state' - {x}. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state' - {x}"
    and "eval_dom x t state
         ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
         ⟹ called state ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ {u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state
         ⟹ {u ∈ called state'. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state'"
proof (induction y x state and x phase state and x t state
       arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
       rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    have IH: "{u ∈ called state1 - {x}. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state'"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3)] Query.prems(2-4) Iterate(4)
      by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate(1,4) slookup_fminsert_other[of _ x "infl state1" y] c_same(2)[OF Iterate(2,3)]
      by force
  next
    case Lookup
    show ?thesis
      using Query.prems(2-4) Lookup(3) slookup_fminsert_other[of _ x "infl state" y]
      by force
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x phase state)
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(5) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
      using Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) TD.stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"
      using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1) _ Fixpoint(4)] Fixpoint(5) Iterate.prems(3-4)
      by force
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
      using W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) TD.stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"
      using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then have IH1: "{u ∈ called state1. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) _ W_Fixpoint(5)] Iterate.prems(2-4)
      by auto
    have stabl_infl_props:
      "insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state1"
      "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
      "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u)
        ∩ (insert x (stabl state) - {x}) = {}"
      using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(4,5)] Iterate.prems(3-4)
      by auto
    have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u" for u
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)]
      by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
    then have "slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}" if "slookup infl2 u ≠ {}" for u
      using that by (metis subset_empty)
    then have "{u ∈ called state1 - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1 - {x}"
      using IH1 Iterate.prems(2) by blast
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF W_Fixpoint(8)] stabl_infl_props(2) by blast
    moreover have "called state - {x} ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "influenced_by (infl state1) x ∩ stabl state = {}"
        using TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x]
          W_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_props(3)
        by blast
      then have "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
        using stabl_infl_props(1) destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)]
        by blast
      then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by auto
    qed
    ultimately have IH2:
      "{u ∈ called state' - {x}. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state' - {x}"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) _ W_Fixpoint(5) _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ _ W_Fixpoint(7,8) _
          W_Fixpoint(10)] W_Fixpoint(2,3) Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(4,5)]
      by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
      using N_Fixpoint(1) Iterate.prems(4) TD.stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"
      using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then have "{u ∈ called state'. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1) _ N_Fixpoint(5)] Iterate.prems(3,4) N_Fixpoint(8)
      by auto
    then show ?thesis using N_Fixpoint(8) Iterate.prems(2) by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
      using Continue(1) Iterate.prems(4) TD.stabl_infl_empty by fast
    then have "{u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"
      using Iterate.prems(5) by blast
    then have IH1: "{u ∈ called state1. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3)] Iterate.prems(3-5)
      by auto
    have stabl_infl_props:
      "insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state1"
      "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
      "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u)
        ∩ (insert x (stabl state) - {x}) = {}"
      using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF Continue(2,3)] Iterate.prems(3,4) by auto
    have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u" for u
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
      by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
    then have "slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}" if "slookup infl2 u ≠ {}" for u
      using that by (metis subset_empty)
    then have "{u ∈ called state1 - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1 - {x}"
      using IH1 by blast
    moreover have "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
      using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF Continue(6)] stabl_infl_props(2) by simp
    moreover have "called state - {x} ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "influenced_by (infl state1) x ∩ stabl state = {}"
        using TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x]
          Continue(1) Iterate.prems(4) stabl_infl_props(3)
        by blast
      then have "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
        using stabl_infl_props(1) destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)] by blast
      then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(3) by simp
    qed
    ultimately have IH2: "{u ∈ called state' - {x}. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state' - {x}"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3) _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(8)]
        Iterate.prems(2) c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)]
      by auto
    then show ?thesis using IH1 by force
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have IH1: "{u ∈ called state1. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2-4)
      by auto
    note stabl_infl_props = stabl_infl_properties(1)[OF Query(2,3) Eval.prems(2,3)]
    then show ?thesis
      using IH1 Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5)] Eval.prems(2) c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3)]
      by auto
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2-4) by auto
  qed
qed


abbreviation point_invariant where
  "point_invariant state ≡
  point state ⊆ called state ∧ {u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"

lemma well_formed_point_set:
    shows "query_dom y x state
      ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
      ⟹ called state ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ point_invariant state
      ⟹ point_invariant state'"
      and "iterate_dom x wn state
      ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x wn state
      ⟹ x ∈ called state
      ⟹ called state - {x} ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ point_invariant (state⦇called := called state - {x}, point := point state - {x}⦈)
      ⟹ point_invariant (state'⦇called := called state' - {x},
          point := point state' - {x}⦈) ∧ x ∉ point state'"
      and "eval_dom x t state
      ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
      ⟹ called state ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
      ⟹ point_invariant state
      ⟹ point_invariant state'"
proof goal_cases
  case 1
  show ?case
    using point_set_subset_c(1)[OF 1(1-2)] called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point(1)[OF 1(1-4)] 1(5)
    by simp
next
  case 2
  show ?case
    using point_set_subset_c(2)[OF 2(1-3)] called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point(2)[OF 2(1-5)] 2(6)
    by auto
next
  case 3
  show ?case
    using point_set_subset_c(3)[OF 3(1-2)] called_with_non_empty_infl_in_point(3)[OF 3(1-4)] 3(5)
    by simp
qed


subsubsection‹Termination Proof›

text‹In the following, we carry out a conditional termination proof for the three mutual recursive
  functions of the solver. The condition demands some well-formedness properties about the solver's
  data structures and is defined as follows.›

abbreviation term_cond_aux where
  "term_cond_aux state ≡ point state ⊆ called state ∧ called state ⊆ stabl state ∧
     fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state ∧
     {u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"

abbreviation term_cond where
  "term_cond st ≡ (case st of
      Inl (y, x, state) ⇒ term_cond_aux state
    | Inr (Inl (x, phase, state)) ⇒
        x ∈ called state ∧ term_cond_aux (state⦇called := called state - {x}, point := point state - {x}⦈)
    | Inr (Inr (x, t, state)) ⇒ term_cond_aux state)"


text‹With the following lemma we prove that a call to any of the three mutually recursive functions
  terminates as long as the parameters fulfill the above stated termination condition. As this
  condition is fulfilled by the initial solver state we can later derive that the solver
  always terminates. The proof is an induction with the well-founded @{term term_relation}
  constructed above. To apply the induction hypotheses, it thus needs to be shown, that the
  parameters of a recursive function call decrease compared to the parameters of the wrapping
  function call and with respect to the @{term term_relation}.›

lemma cond_termination: "query_iterate_eval_dom st" if "term_cond st"
  using wf_term_relation that
proof (induction st rule: wf_induct_rule[where ?r = term_relation])
  case (less st)
  then consider (Query) y x state where "st = Inl (y, x, state)"
    | (Iterate) x wn state where "st = Inr (Inl (x, wn, state))"
    | (Eval) x t state where "st = Inr (Inr (x, t, state))"
    by (auto split: sum.splits)
  then show ?case
  proof cases
    case Query
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "x ∈ called state")
      case True
      then show ?thesis using Query query_iterate_eval.domintros(1) by fast
    next
      case False
      have "point state ⊆ called state" using less.prems Query by simp
      have "card (UNIV - (insert x (called state))) < card (UNIV - called state)"
        using finite_vars False
        by (metis Diff_iff Diff_insert UNIV_I card_Diff1_less finite_Diff)
      then have "(Inr (Inl (x, Widening, state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)), st) ∈ term_relation"
        unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def Query
        by auto
      moreover have "term_cond (Inr (Inl (x, Widening, state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)))"
        using less.prems Query False by auto
      ultimately have "iterate_dom x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
        using less.IH by simp
      then show ?thesis
        using Query False query_iterate_eval.domintros(1) by simp
    qed
  next
    case Iterate
    have xcalled: "x ∈ called state" and p_sub_called: "point state ⊆ called state"
      using Iterate less(2) by auto
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "x ∈ stabl state")
      case True
      then show ?thesis using Iterate query_iterate_eval.domintros(2) by blast
    next
      case False
      have "(Inr (Inr (x, T x, state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)), st) ∈ term_relation"
        using Iterate unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def by simp
      moreover have "term_cond (Inr (Inr (x, T x, state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)))"
      proof -
        have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
          using less.prems Iterate TD.stabl_infl_empty[OF False] by auto
        then show ?thesis using Iterate less.prems by auto
      qed
      ultimately have eval_dom: "eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
        using less.IH by auto
      then obtain xd state1 where
          eval: "(xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
        by (metis surj_pair)
      have stabl_infl_props1: "insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state1"
          "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
          "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
        using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF eval_dom eval] less.prems Iterate False
        by auto
      have non_empty_infl_point1: "point state1 ⊆ called state1"
        "{u ∈ called state1. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
      proof -
        have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
          using False less.prems Iterate TD.stabl_infl_empty by auto
        then have "{u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"
          using less.prems Iterate by auto
        then show "point state1 ⊆ called state1"
            "{u ∈ called state1. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
          using well_formed_point_set(3)[OF eval_dom eval] less.prems Iterate by auto
      qed

      obtain infl2 stabl2 where
        destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
        by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") simp
      have term_cond2: "point state1 ⊆ called state1"
          "called state1 - {x} ⊆ stabl2" "fset (fmdom infl2) ⊆ stabl2"
          "{u ∈ called state1 - {x}. slookup infl2 u ≠ {}} ⊆ (point state1) - {x}"
      proof (goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case using ‹point state1 ⊆ called state1› by auto
      next
        case 2
        have "influenced_by (infl state1) x ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
          using TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x] False stabl_infl_props1(3)
            less.prems Iterate
          by auto
        then have "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
          using ‹insert x (stabl state) ⊆ stabl state1› destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab]
          by blast
        then show ?case using Iterate less.prems c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case
          using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF destab] stabl_infl_props1(2)
          by simp
      next
        case 4
        have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u" for u
          using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab]
          by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
        then show ?case using non_empty_infl_point1 subset_empty by fastforce
      qed

      show ?thesis
      proof (cases "x ∈ point state")
        case True
        then show ?thesis
        proof (cases wn)
          case Widening
          show ?thesis
          proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd")
            case True
            show ?thesis
            proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd = mlup (σ state1) x")
              case True
              then show ?thesis
                using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∈ point state› eval_dom eval
                  ‹mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd› Widening
                  query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state wn]
                by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
            next
              case False
              define st' where st':
                "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
                Inr (Inl (x, Narrowing, state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
                  σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈))"
              have "iterate_dom x Narrowing (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
                  σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈)"
              proof (cases "x ∈ point state1")
                case True
                have "insert x ((called state) - {x}) = called state" using less(2) Iterate by auto
                then have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
                  using st' Iterate ‹x ∈ point state› Widening True c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval]
                  unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def value_relation_def
                  by auto
                moreover have "term_cond st'"
                  using term_cond2 st' xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
                ultimately show ?thesis
                  using less(1) st' ‹point state1 ⊆ called state1› xcalled by force
              next
                case False
                then have "slookup (infl state1) x = {}"
                  using non_empty_infl_point1 xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
                then have "influenced_by (infl state1) x = {}"
                  by (metis influenced_by_aux UN_E all_not_in_conv)
                then have "x ∈ stabl2"
                  using destab_infl_stabl_relation destab stabl_infl_props1(1)
                  by fastforce
                then show ?thesis
                  using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x] by fastforce
              qed
              then show ?thesis
                using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∈ point state› eval_dom eval
                  ‹mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd›
                  destab Widening query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
                by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
                    cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)", cases wn) auto
            qed
          next
            case False
            define st' where st':
              "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
              Inr (Inl (x, wn, state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
                σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd)⦈))"
            have "iterate_dom x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
                σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd)⦈)"
            proof (cases "x ∈ point state1")
              case True
              moreover have "(mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd)) x, mlup (σ state) x)
                ∈ widening_chains"
              proof -
                have "mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd)) x = mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd"
                  unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
                moreover have "mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state) x"
                  using constant_vals_for_called(3)[OF eval_dom eval] xcalled by simp
                moreover have "mlup (σ state) x ∇ xd ≠ mlup (σ state) x"
                  using False ‹mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state) x› by simp
                ultimately show ?thesis unfolding widening_chains by auto
              qed
              ultimately have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
                using st' Iterate ‹x ∈ point state› Widening c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval]
                unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def value_relation_def by simp
              moreover have "term_cond st'"
                using term_cond2 st' xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
              ultimately show ?thesis
                using less st' Iterate ‹point state1 ⊆ called state1› xcalled by force
            next
              case False
              then have "slookup (infl state1) x = {}"
                using non_empty_infl_point1 ‹x ∈ called state› c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
              then have "influenced_by (infl state1) x = {}"
                by (metis influenced_by_aux UN_E all_not_in_conv)
              then have "x ∈ stabl2"
                using destab_infl_stabl_relation destab stabl_infl_props1(1) by fastforce
              then show ?thesis
                using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x "state1⦇infl := infl2,
                    stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd)⦈"]
                by simp
            qed
            then show ?thesis
              using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∈ point state› eval_dom eval False destab Widening
                query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
              by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
                  cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)", cases wn) auto
          qed
        next
          case Narrowing
          show ?thesis
          proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd")
            case True
            then show ?thesis
              using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∈ point state› eval_dom eval Narrowing
              query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
            by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
          next
            case False
            define st' where st':
              "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
              Inr (Inl (x, wn, state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
              σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈))"
            have "iterate_dom x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
              σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈)"
            proof (cases "x ∈ point state1")
              case True
              moreover have "(mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)) x, mlup (σ state) x)
                ∈ narrowing_chains"
              proof -
                have "mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)) x = mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd"
                  unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
                moreover have "mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state) x"
                  using constant_vals_for_called(3)[OF eval_dom eval] xcalled by simp
                moreover have "mlup (σ state) x Δ xd ≠ mlup (σ state) x"
                  using False ‹mlup (σ state1) x = mlup (σ state) x› by auto
                ultimately show ?thesis unfolding narrowing_chains by auto
              qed
              ultimately have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
                using Iterate st' Narrowing c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval]
                unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def value_relation_def
                by simp
              moreover have "term_cond st'"
                using term_cond2 st' xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
              ultimately show ?thesis
                using less st' Iterate ‹point state1 ⊆ called state1› xcalled by force
            next
              case False
              then have "slookup (infl state1) x = {}"
                using non_empty_infl_point1 xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
              then have "influenced_by (infl state1) x = {}"
                using influenced_by_aux by force 
              then have "x ∈ stabl2"
                using destab_infl_stabl_relation destab stabl_infl_props1(1) by fastforce
              then show ?thesis
                using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x "state1⦇infl := infl2,
                    stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd)⦈"]
                by simp
            qed
            then show ?thesis
              using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∈ point state› eval_dom eval False destab Narrowing
                query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
              by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
                  cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)", cases wn) auto
          qed
        qed
      next
        case False
        show ?thesis
        proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x = xd")
          case True
          then show ?thesis
            using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∉ point state› eval_dom eval
              query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
            by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
        next
          case False
          define st' where st': "st' :: ('x,'d) query_in + ('x,'d) iterate_in + ('x,'d) eval_in ≡
            Inr (Inl (x, wn, state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ xd)⦈))"

          have "iterate_dom x wn (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ xd)⦈)"
          proof (cases "x ∈ point state1")
            case True
            then have "(st', st) ∈ term_relation"
              using st' Iterate ‹x ∉ point state› c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval]
              unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def by simp
            moreover have "term_cond st'"
              using term_cond2 st' xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis
              using less st' Iterate ‹point state1 ⊆ called state1› xcalled by force
          next
            case False
            have prems: "point state ⊆ called state" "called state ⊆ insert x (stabl state)"
                "fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state"
                "{u ∈ called state - {x}. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state - {x}"
              using less.prems Iterate by auto
            have "called state ⊆ stabl state1"
              using stabl_infl_properties(3)[OF eval_dom eval] prems(2,3) stabl_infl_props1(1)
              by blast
            have "{u ∈ called state. slookup (infl state) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state"
            proof -
              have "slookup (infl state) x = {}"
                using ‹x ∉ stabl state› prems(3) TD.stabl_infl_empty by simp
              then show ?thesis using prems(4) by auto
            qed
            then have "{u ∈ called state1. slookup (infl state1) u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state1"
              using well_formed_point_set(3)[OF eval_dom eval] prems(1-3) by auto
            then have "slookup (infl state1) x = {}"
              using False xcalled c_same(3)[OF eval_dom eval] by auto
            then have "influenced_by (infl state1) x = {}" using influenced_by_aux by force
            then have "stabl state1 = stabl2"
              using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] by simp
            then have "x ∈ stabl2" using xcalled ‹called state ⊆ stabl state1› by blast
            then show ?thesis using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2) by force
          qed
          then show ?thesis
            using Iterate ‹x ∉ stabl state› ‹x ∉ point state› eval_dom eval False destab
              query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
            by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
                cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)", cases wn) auto
        qed
      qed
    qed
  next
    case Eval
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases t)
      case (Answer d)
      then show ?thesis using Eval query_iterate_eval.domintros(3) by auto
    next
      case (Query y g)
      have "(Inl (x, y, state), st) ∈ term_relation"
        unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def Eval by simp
      moreover have "term_cond (Inl (x, y, state))" using less.prems Eval by simp
      ultimately have query_dom: "query_dom x y state" using less.IH by simp
      then obtain d' state' where query: "(d', state') = query x y state"
        by (cases "query x y state") auto
      have "eval_dom x (g d') state'"
      proof -
        have "d' = mlup (σ state') y" using query_fmlookup query_dom_def query query_dom by metis
        then have "(g d', t) ∈ strict_subt_relation" using Query direct_subt.intros by fastforce
        then have "(Inr (Inr (x, g d', state')), st) ∈ term_relation"
          using Eval c_same(1)[OF query_dom query] unfolding term_relation_def prod_relation_def
          by simp
        moreover have "term_cond (Inr (Inr (x, g d', state')))"
        proof -
          have "stabl state ⊆ stabl state'" "fset (fmdom (infl state')) ⊆ stabl state'"
              "(∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ (stabl state - {x}) = {})"
            using less.prems Eval stabl_infl_properties(1)[OF query_dom query] by auto
          moreover have "called state ⊆ stabl state" using less.prems Eval by simp
          moreover have "point state' ⊆ called state'"
              "{u ∈ called state'. slookup (infl state') u ≠ {}} ⊆ point state'"
            using less.prems Eval well_formed_point_set(1)[OF query_dom query]
            by auto
          ultimately show ?thesis using c_same(1)[OF query_dom query] by auto
        qed
        ultimately show ?thesis using less.IH unfolding eval_dom_def by auto
      qed
      then show ?thesis
        using Eval Query query_dom query unfolding query_dom_def
        by (auto intro: query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[of _ x state] split: prod.splits)
    qed
  qed
qed

corollary solve_termination: "solve_dom x"
  unfolding solve_dom_def iterate_dom_def by (auto intro: cond_termination)

end
end
